title: Vault Schema Note Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema export generated from canonical vault-schema.json for public-safe note frontmatter validation.

project.description: Short project code for retrieval and human queries, normally an abbreviation of the project name, e.g. bam. Must not duplicate project_slug when a separate project code exists.

project_slug.description: Canonical project note slug/filename stem for the project note, e.g. 2026-05-bam.

source.description: Origin system (manual, codex-chat, telegram, apple-mail, imessage, browser)

source_id.description: Stable source identifier for automated captures

reply_to.description: Slug or source_id this note replies to

agent.description: Agent that produced the captured answer when applicable

generated_from.description: Source contract, note, or export that generated this artifact

sources.description: Source paths, URLs, or source_ids used for compiled synthesis

source_hash.description: Hash of raw/source content when drift detection is useful

source_hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm for source_hash, usually sha256

source_checked_at.description: Timestamp/date when the raw/source hash or URL was last checked

confidence.description: Evidence confidence for generated/evidence notes; use high/medium/low or a numeric model confidence

contested.description: True when the note contains unresolved contradiction or competing claims

contradictions.description: Related slugs/paths/source_ids that conflict with this note

supersedes.description: Older slugs/paths/source_ids this note replaces or materially updates
